VisaBlock.title: Turkmenistan visa and letter of invitation
VisaBlock.text: A tourist visa for Turkmenistan is not issued without a letter of invitation from a licensed local operator. We arrange the invitation ourselves: you send a passport copy and the application form, the rest is our job.
steps: Choose a tour and agree the dates with us.
Send a passport copy and the completed application form.
Receive the approved letter of invitation — usually within 2–3 weeks.
Collect the visa at the embassy or on arrival at Ashgabat airport.

items.q: Do I need a visa for Turkmenistan?
items.a: Yes, citizens of most countries do. A tourist visa is issued only on the basis of a letter of invitation from a licensed Turkmen operator — we arrange it for you, so there is no separate application to make.

items.q: How long does the invitation take?
items.a: Usually 2–3 weeks from the moment we receive your passport copy and application form. It is best to start at least a month before the trip.

items.q: Is Turkmenistan safe to travel in?
items.a: Yes. Street crime is rare, and a guide and driver accompany you along the route. Some areas require permits — we obtain those in advance.

items.q: What is included in the tour price?
items.a: As a rule: the invitation, transport along the route, accommodation, meals per the programme, a guide and entrance fees. The exact included and excluded list is on each tour page.

items.q: Can I travel on my own rather than in a group?
items.a: Yes. We build a private tour around your dates, pace and interests — we will send the programme and the price after a short conversation.

items.q: What languages do the guides speak?
items.a: Russian, English and Turkmen. Other languages on request, if you let us know in advance.

About.title: About Us
About.text: Welcome to SAYODA TRAVEL, your gateway to the breathtaking landscapes, rich history, and vibrant cultures of Central Asia. As a licensed Turkmen tour operator, we specialize in carefully curated tours across Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan, and Kazakhstan, offering unforgettable travel experiences.

Services.title: SERVICES
Services.text: We offer a variety of travel experiences to help you explore Central Asia with ease:
cardtext: Tailor-made itineraries for solo travelers, groups, and families.
Guided tours to UNESCO sites, local crafts, and traditions.
